## Summary

Beyond the bundled xLua framework (in `Assets/XLua/`), the project has a **custom-built hot-update (热更新) system** for **Rune (符文) values** that loads Lua scripts from either an AssetBundle (hotfix CDN) or a Resources fallback, and applies rune effects to player attributes via reflection.

---

## 1. Lua Script Files (.lua and .lua.txt)

- **`Assets/Resources/Lua/Main.lua.txt`** — Lua entry point; requires all modules:
  ```lua
  local RuneConfig = require("Config.RuneConfig")
  local RuneEffect = require("Logic.RuneEffect")
  local RuneSpecialPower = require("Logic.RuneSpecialPower")
  return { RuneConfig = RuneConfig, RuneEffect = RuneEffect, RuneSpecialPower = RuneSpecialPower }
